policy.canonical_boundary: A records evidence and routing only. B/C/D canonical standards may be changed only by their owning sessions.
policy.project_gt_core: Generalize reusable project implementation and route candidate with exact revision evidence.
policy.core_gt_project: Record migration/backport gap with breaking impact and verification needs.
policy.different: Record distinct problem/evidence without forcing promotion when neither side is strictly ahead.

findings.summary: Machine-enforced semantic UI role/token conformance against effective implementation selectors.

state_history.reason: Independent project evidence satisfies A cross-project routing threshold.

findings.summary: Bind proof to source/checker/fixture input digests so changed verification inputs stale prior evidence.

state_history.reason: Project-verified C candidate; second independent project still required for broader adoption evidence.

findings.summary: Reverse-order domain compensation for already-applied effects with explicit partial-state escalation when compensation fails.

state_history.reason: Project-verified D candidate; second independent project remains required.

findings.summary: ERP4 corrected a stale audit-ledger contradiction but still lacks a durable exact-revision consistency validator.

breaking_impact: Resolved work can be reopened from stale metadata.
Duplicate append/correction cycles can recur.
Operational decision state can diverge while application data remains unaffected.
verification_needs: Reconcile central ledger, AI entrypoint and latest detail at one exact revision.
Fail CI on contradictory latest-state claims.
Include a negative fixture reproducing the stale Audit78 ledger-gap claim.

state_history.reason: Audit79 corrected the contradiction but prevention remains manual.
Latest ERP4 Audit80 head still does not implement the three-surface audit metadata consistency validator.

findings.summary: Expected logical schedule slot, actual dispatch identity, lateness/miss classification and downstream completion must remain distinguishable.
findings.difference_reason: ERP4 proves the ambiguity through a very-late successful native run, while AI Core has adjacent recovery/SLA semantics but no reusable solved logical-slot identity implementation.

state_history.reason: Phase-2 research candidate; failure/runtime evidence only.

findings.summary: FreePass Admin consumes C Application Service contracts in SHADOW/PARTIAL form but lacks verified production persistence, actor-provider, durable receipt and runtime bindings.

breaking_impact: Development bindings can be mistaken for production conformance.
Actor/authentication authority can be overstated while the production provider is unbound.
Critical mutations can report success without durable Core receipt/provenance proof.
Release claims can exceed exact production runtime evidence.
verification_needs: Bind exact production persistence adapters.
Bind a fail-closed production ActorProvider.
Prove critical-write idempotency and durable receipt evidence.
Prove production audit retention.
Prove exact release/runtime revision before promotion.

state_history.reason: Admin C adoption is implemented only as SHADOW/PARTIAL and production bindings remain unverified.

findings.summary: ERP4/ERP5 implements and CI-verifies a Core ingest receipt shadow, but receipt build/upload is non-blocking and production scheduled receipt evidence remains unverified.

breaking_impact: A supplier PARTIAL/FAILED apply can still finish without durable machine receipt if the shadow evidence path fails.
Downstream recovery can lack authoritative partial-state provenance.
Operational status can diverge from supplier-level receipt state.
CI-only proof can be mistaken for production receipt conformance.
verification_needs: Observe retained receipt artifacts from real production ERP5 refresh runs at an exact project revision.
Verify receipt schema conformance and sensitive-data exclusion.
Verify PARTIAL and FAILED behavior with real or controlled evidence.
Verify retention and retrievability.
Define fail-closed behavior when a required receipt cannot be built or uploaded.
Add publication-orchestration receipt if the C boundary requires it.

state_history.reason: Receipt shadow is implemented and CI-verified but remains non-blocking and lacks exact-head production observation.

findings.summary: ERP4 SSOT Source Contract checks C shadow surfaces on pull requests but omits the same paths from main push filters, leaving a fail-open enforcement gap.

breaking_impact: A main-only change to C shadow contracts, projection code or checker can bypass the resulting-main Source Contract run.
PR success cannot be treated as fail-closed enforcement while main has no required status checks.
verification_needs: Make push path coverage include the same C shadow surfaces as pull_request coverage or establish an equivalent fail-closed main gate.
Add a negative/trigger fixture proving a shadow-only main change schedules the Source Contract workflow.
Observe a green resulting-main run at the exact fixed revision.

state_history.reason: Audit80 proves pull-request and main-push path filters are asymmetric for the new C shadow surfaces.

findings.summary: Permit valid monotonic forward workflow skips without fabricating skipped completion evidence, while recording explicit inferred-prerequisite provenance when later verified facts logically imply a prerequisite.

state_history.reason: Sales exact-head code, tests and CI prove forward-skip evidence integrity; routed to D primary and C provenance review without any canonical edit.

findings.summary: FreePass Sales maps to the AI Core B UI/UX consumer contract but remains MAPPED rather than revision-bound conformant because locale, RTL, IME and complete rendered evidence are still missing.

breaking_impact: MAPPED UI can be misreported as PILOT or CONFORMANT without revision-bound evidence.
Localization, RTL, IME and responsive behavior can be overstated outside the verified matrix.
A copied product mapping can be mistaken for B canonical behavior.
verification_needs: Keep exact-head consumer mapping CI green.
Produce a revision-bound B4 conformance receipt.
Complete locale, RTL and IME probes required by the consumer mapping.
Retain full rendered evidence for the declared viewport matrix.
Bind production-conformance claims to an exact released revision.

state_history.reason: Sales B consumer mapping is CI-verified at exact head, but the project still lacks the revision-bound conformance evidence required to move beyond MAPPED.

findings.summary: FreePass Sales implements and tests fail-closed customer-search and promotion receipt shadow contracts, but production read binding and durable runtime receipt persistence remain unverified.

breaking_impact: SMS app launch can be mistaken for business completion.
A confirmed send followed by server record failure can lose durable PARTIAL evidence.
Source-read failure can be mistaken for a legitimate empty result if callers bypass the fail-closed adapter.
CI-verified shadow semantics can be mistaken for production receipt durability.
verification_needs: Bind customer search to the intended production read boundary and prove fail-closed behavior.
Persist and retrieve promotion receipts in the real runtime.
Verify HOLD, PARTIAL and SUCCEEDED with controlled or production evidence.
Verify receipt retention and sensitive-data exclusion.
Bind runtime evidence to the exact deployed Sales revision before promotion beyond SHADOW.

state_history.reason: Sales C adapters and receipt semantics are exact-head CI verified, but production runtime binding and durable receipt evidence are not yet observed.

findings.summary: FreePass Admin now proves exact-revision D workflow/projection parity in SHADOW mode, but Admin domain code remains runtime write authority and Core command/guard enforcement is not cut over.

breaking_impact: Two workflow authorities can be conflated even though only Admin writes runtime state.
Command and guard semantics can diverge despite projection parity.
Cancellation, rejection and persistence side effects may differ during later cutover.
Rollback and audit atomicity can be assumed without runtime evidence.
verification_needs: Bind approved Admin use cases into the D decision and workflow engine boundary.
Prove stable error mapping during cutover.
Prove persistence and audit atomicity.
Test rollback or compensation paths.
Bind exact-revision CI to production runtime and deployment evidence before promotion beyond SHADOW.

state_history.reason: Admin D projection parity is exact-head CI verified in SHADOW mode, but D is not yet the runtime write authority.

findings.summary: Capability ownership cutover must verify the replacement against the same source while preventing dual scheduled execution, then disable the old path only after successful replacement evidence.

state_history.reason: AIOps now contains the replacement RTDB backup engine and an explicit no-dual-run cutover gate; route to D without changing D canon.
